proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend: connection handshake/state-machine compatibility, QP/ECE setup, GID/FLID routing, traffic-class handling, receive-size reporting, and IB default behavior updates. Added memory-registration caching with refcounted MR ownership/deregistration is an independently substantive memory-management change. GIN paths are also substantively changed (GIN connect/accept/cancel/close integration and listener cleanup semantics), so GIN expertise is required beyond caller-only edits.
